shorts.title: 到任第一夜，门外有人借火

shots.image_prompt: close-up of a weathered wooden door at night, snow drifting in the gap under it, faint lantern glow outside

lines.t: 半夜，有人敲门。
借个火。

shots.image_prompt: the man walks behind an old gatekeeper through a snowy courtyard at dusk toward a small dark room at the back wall

lines.t: 沈砚十九岁，刚当上县里的录异吏，
专管乡下报上来的怪事。

shots.image_prompt: an old gatekeeper standing in snow outside a doorway, hunched, looking sideways toward the courtyard wall, lantern in hand

lines.t: 门房把钥匙一放，没进屋，只说了一句：
夜里要是有人敲门，你别开。

shots.image_prompt: the man sits up on a narrow wooden bed in a dark small room, only the outline visible, a faint glow under the door

lines.t: 二更天，门真响了。三下，不轻不重。
门外的声音有点哑，像是站了很久。

shots.image_prompt: the man holds an oil lamp at an open door, snow blowing in, the doorway outside empty and dark

lines.t: 他点上灯，拔了门闩。
门外没有人。

shots.image_prompt: a plain white paper lantern sitting on fresh snow at a threshold, a thin wisp of smoke rising from inside it, low angle

lines.t: 只有一盏灯笼，端端正正放在雪地上。
蜡烛刚灭，还冒着一缕烟。

shots.image_prompt: close-up of a young man's hand touching the bamboo handle of a paper lantern in the snow, lamplight

lines.t: 他摸了一下灯笼柄。
是热的，像被人攥了很久。

shots.image_prompt: a dark snowy courtyard at night seen from a doorway, a single line of footprints leading away into the mist

lines.t: 完整故事，在《录异簿》第一章。

shorts.title: 雪地上的脚印，走到井边就断了

shots.image_prompt: a single line of footprints in fresh snow ending exactly at the edge of an old stone well at night

lines.t: 脚印走到井边，就没了。

shots.image_prompt: the man crouches by a doorway at night holding an oil lamp, looking at footprints in the snow, seen from behind

lines.t: 半夜有人敲门借火，开门却没人。
沈砚举着灯，往雪地上照。

shots.image_prompt: close-up of flat-soled footprints in snow, evenly spaced, lamplight from the side, snowflakes falling

lines.t: 一行脚印，鞋底是平的，
一步一步，走得很稳，一点不慌。

shots.image_prompt: the man walks slowly through a snowy courtyard at night beside a line of footprints, lamp held low, mist

lines.t: 他贴着脚印旁边走，一步也不踩坏它。
走了二十来步，脚印拐向西角。

shots.image_prompt: an old stone well with a wooden windlass and a frozen rope in a snowy corner of a courtyard at night, lantern light

lines.t: 西角有一口井。
井沿上的雪，化成水又冻成了冰。

shots.image_prompt: looking down into a deep dark well from above, a lamp held over the opening, only blackness below

lines.t: 他往井里照，只看见黑。
连水声都没有。

shots.image_prompt: wide shot of a snowy courtyard around an old well at night, untouched snow all around, one figure standing beside it

lines.t: 他绕着井走了一圈。四周的雪平平整整。
那个人走到井边，就再没离开。

shots.image_prompt: a paper lantern resting on the icy rim of a well at night, mist rising from the dark opening

lines.t: 完整故事，在《录异簿》第一章。

shorts.title: 三年前，他也写过同一句话

shots.image_prompt: an old thread-bound notebook open on a wooden desk by oil lamp light, one page torn out at the root, close-up

lines.t: 这本簿子，被人撕掉了七页。

shots.image_prompt: the man opens an old wooden chest in a dim room, an old notebook with a blue cloth cover inside, lamplight

lines.t: 沈砚当上录异吏，接手了上一任留下的《录异簿》。
上一任姓陆，三年前出城办差，再没回来。

shots.image_prompt: close-up of a slip of paper tucked between pages of an old notebook, oil lamp glow, shallow depth of field

lines.t: 簿子里夹着一张纸条：
存疑一栏，不许空。

shots.image_prompt: the man writing with a brush in a notebook at night by an oil lamp, frost on the window, seen from the side

lines.t: 到任头一夜，有人敲门借火，门外只剩一盏灯笼。
他把这件事，一笔一笔记了下来。

shots.image_prompt: pages of an old notebook flipping by themselves on a desk, the lamp flame bending, dark room

lines.t: 手一滑，簿子往前翻了好几页。

shots.image_prompt: extreme close-up of an old yellowed page with dense handwriting, lamp light, the writing out of focus

lines.t: 那一页，是陆先生的字。
腊月十三，二更后。叩门三声，言借火。

shots.image_prompt: the man sits motionless at a desk at dawn, the oil lamp burned low, pale blue light at the window

lines.t: 和他今夜写的，一字不差。
后面几页，都被撕掉了。

shots.image_prompt: an old notebook closed on a desk beside a cold paper lantern, early morning light, quiet room

lines.t: 完整故事，在《录异簿》第一章。
